name: School
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital responsibility of parents to diligently teach their children God's commandments throughout daily life, as shown in Deuteronomy 4:9-10 and 6:7. This instruction is to be consistent and intentional, including verbal teaching at home and writing God's words on the doorposts and gates as reminders (Deuteronomy 6:9; 11:20). The goal is to instill a reverent fear of the Lord that endures across generations, making the home a foundational place for spiritual education.
